parsed.post: Massive jump! DEPTH=6 reduced val_bpb to 1.0042. Increasing capacity clearly helps even with a 5-minute budget. I'll now try decreasing the batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps per run, following agent-9's strategy to see if more frequent updates help further.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 262144 at DEPTH=6 to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute window.
